### SafqahLogo

Safqah master brand mark, stacked Main or inline Variant, in seven brand colours.

Level: atom

Use when:
- Splash, headers and marketing (Form=Main)
- App bars, footers and email signatures (Form=Variant)

Don't use when:
- For loading states use SpinnerSafqahBrand
- Never recolour outside the seven Color values

Accessibility: Alt text «صفقة المالية».

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

This is Safqah’s own logo - unlike Abshir/Mada, its colours ARE our brand colours. Every variant is vector-accurate to the supplied assets (SVG/PNG); PDFs are left as print masters.

### Forms

### Main - stacked

Two-line lockup (صفقة / المالية). The default; use it wherever there is vertical room - splash, headers, marketing.

### Variant - inline

Single-line lockup (صفقة المالية). For tight/wide spaces - app bars, footers, email signatures.

### Colours

Seven brand colours. PigmentGreen is primary; RoyalGreen secondary; Yellow accent; Dark/Black for mono on light; White/Offwhite for on dark.

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Lead with the Main logo in PigmentGreen on light neutral surfaces.

Do

On dark surfaces or photography, switch to White or Offwhite.

Don’t

Don’t stretch, distort, or rotate - keep the exact vector and its proportions.

Don’t

Don’t use off-brand colours - only the seven brand colours are permitted.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Vector-rebuilt from the official SVGs (Main viewBox 698×477, Variant 1446×252). PNGs match; PDFs were left as-is per instruction (print masters).

> **Tip:** Colour is a single flat fill across the whole lockup - recolour by swapping the Color variant, never by editing individual paths.

> **Warning:** This is the master brand mark - its seven colours are the ONLY allowed fills. Everything around it must use DS tokens.
